incident-bot: [INCIDENT] Pager: calderapay-prod — elevated 5xx + token errors in customer VPC dedicated pool. Sev2. Incident page: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2468
ava_oncall: taking the page, joining bridge in 2m. @ryan_sre @maria_eng can you start digging into node logs?
ryan_sre: seeing a pattern — sporadic KV cache evictions + retry storms. Several GPU workers reporting OOM and model timeouts around 13:02 UTC. Logs: `kvcache/miss_rate: 0.78`
maria_eng: tracing requests — fraud-check route (caldera-payments) spikes latency and then 502 from model proxy. Likely model variant memory pressure with long seqs.
samir_cs: pinged CalderaPay account team — they're seeing ~15% error rate on /v1/fraud API and some failed payments. Customer is nervous, wants ETA.
ava_oncall: quick mitigation proposal:
```
# tenant override
tenant: caldera-pay
pin_variant: caldera-gptx-v1-quant8
rollout: immediate
fallthrough: route->hosted-safe-variant
```
Goal: move traffic off high-mem variant to quantized safe variant in VPC pool while we stabilize.
ryan_sre: agree. quant8 variant has smaller KV footprint. I'll push tenant override now and throttle concurrency on affected nodes.
nancy_support: I'll draft a short message for CalderaPay: "We're routing your fraud-check traffic to a memory-safe model variant to restore availability. No data left our VPC. ETA 15-30m." Thoughts?
ava_oncall: please send that. ops-bot: apply override: tenant=caldera-pay variant=caldera-gptx-v1-quant8 immediate
ops-bot: override applied (request_id=op-9923). Live metrics: 5xx rate dropping, avg latency down ~40%.
ryan_sre: adding extra heap headroom on two nodes and increasing KV eviction threshold from 0.6 -> 0.75 to avoid cascading evictions.
maria_eng: running a controlled canary for 5% traffic for 10m before full flip; telemetry looks good.
samir_cs: customer updated: "thanks — saw errors decrease already, please keep us posted."
ava_oncall: handing off to @maria_eng for next 30m watch. I'm OOTO after handoff. If regression, escalate to eng-sre pager.
maria_eng: noted. I'll monitor traces and prepare rollback plan. If errors >1% for 5m, revert to hosted fallback and engage infra.
ops-bot: metrics stabilized. 5xxs down to 0.6%. Can close once stable 30m.
maria_eng: closing in 28m if steady. Final note: postmortem to include root cause hypothesis (KV cache pressure from long-sequence fraud inputs + aggressive memory config) and a runbook action: add tenant-level max_seq and autoscale for mem-pressure.
ava_oncall: thanks team. filing incident ticket INC-2468 and assigning to eng-ml + eng-sre for follow-up.
samir_cs: customer reply: 👍 "appreciate the rapid fix" :thumbsup:
